items.statement: Offering group care raises attendance at eight or more contacts by at least 7 percentage points relative to the comparison hubs, at an incremental cost the board would accept.
items.rationale: The trial suggests an effect of this size (claim c1) and costs are modest per woman (claim c2).
items.risks: Comparison hubs may have changed too; uptake may be lower.

items.statement: Cost per additional attender is lowest for women under 20.
items.rationale: The trial's effect was largest in this group.

items.statement: Groups of 10 to 12 halve the cost difference compared with groups of 8.
items.rationale: Costs fall with group size (claim c2).
